context: User sent a clear desktop-view screenshot showing crops clearly rendered off-center from their plot cells (worst for the strawberry/corn/watermelon positions), confirming the textBaseline fix from v32 (which only fixed the vertical text-anchor issue) wasn't the whole story -- the underlying farmPlots coordinate data itself didn't match the actual background art.
root_cause: farmPlots in world-data.js was a hand-estimated 3x4 grid (likely eyeballed when the world data was first authored) that didn't precisely match the actual tilled-soil positions drawn in the background image (public/assets/world/world_day.png). The drift got progressively worse for lower rows (up to ~2.4% off in y by the last row), which matches the screenshot showing worse misalignment toward the bottom of the farm.
fix_method: Measured the actual plot grid directly from the background image pixel data instead of estimating again by eye: detected all tilled-soil-brown-colored pixel regions via color thresholding, ran connected-component labeling to isolate individual soil patches, took the well-separated (non-touching) patches' centroids, and clustered them into 3 column positions and 4 row positions. This gives coordinates measured directly from the actual art rather than guessed.

verification.method: For each of the 12 new plot coordinates, sampled an 18px-radius window around the corresponding pixel position in the actual background image and measured what fraction of pixels matched the tilled-soil color range.
verification.result: All 12 plots landed at a consistent 61-70% soil-pixel density, essentially identical across every single plot -- strong confirmation that every plot center is now solidly and uniformly positioned within its own soil patch, not partially overlapping a fence/border/neighboring cell.

note_on_v32_fix: The v32 textBaseline='middle' fix (for vertical text-anchor centering) is still correct and necessary on its own -- it fixes how a sprite is centered ON its coordinate. This v33 fix corrects what that coordinate actually IS. Both together should now produce properly centered crops.

regression_suite_rerun.road_graph_integrity: pass (farmPlots isn't part of the road graph/pathfinding, so this change doesn't affect movement logic)
regression_suite_rerun.headless_browser_playthrough: pass (only the expected harmless local-CORS weather-fetch errors)
